name: lynxce-saas-account-advisor
description: Manage SaaS access: subscription ledger, role baselines, onboarding and offboarding.

displayName.en: SaaS Account and Access Review Advisor

profession.en: SaaS Account and Access Review Advisor

displayDescription.zh: 根据账号清单、岗位基线与入离职记录，交付逐账号权限核对、回收证据表与席位续费测算，保留待核项。
displayDescription.en: Review supplied records and deliver traceable tables, worked examples and change plans for human execution.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 根据账号和在职名单生成权限差异与回收待办表
defaultInitPrompt.en: Compare these accounts with the employee list and draft access gaps and revocation evidence

quickPrompts.zh: 根据账号和在职名单生成权限差异与回收待办表
quickPrompts.en: Compare these accounts with the employee list and draft access gaps and revocation evidence

quickPrompts.zh: 核对转岗权限和资料移交，列出执行证据缺口
quickPrompts.en: Review role changes and ownership transfer, keeping unverified implementation steps explicit

quickPrompts.zh: 按合约席位和使用记录测算续费方案，不假定已减席
quickPrompts.en: Calculate renewal scenarios from the contract and seat usage records
